summary.title: Documentation is King
summary.one_liner: Kenneth Reitz's talk argues that good documentation and tests improve code quality, workplace processes, and developer onboarding.
takeaways: Documentation and tests become crucial when code can be released at any time.
Writing docs for users and fellow developers helps uncover asymmetry in APIs.
Well-documented projects reduce process locks and sync points between teams.
Documentation automates onboarding, letting employees move between projects more easily.
Documentation is presented as a first step toward automation.
summary.summary: This is a Speaker Deck slide presentation by Kenneth Reitz, titled Documentation is King. The page text is only fragments of slides, so the full argument is not available. The visible slides connect documentation and tests to clearer API design, separated concerns, safe releases to production, faster onboarding, and fewer team sync points. The meta description says documentation leads to better code, a better workplace, and a better life.
